model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different educational methods across three subjects: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, while the horizontal axis lists the subjects. Each bar is color-coded to represent a specific educational method: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (orange), GRPO (green), SRPO (light blue), PPO+Self-reflection (dark green), and PPO (red). The bars are grouped by subject, allowing for a comparison of the methods within each subject. The accuracy percentages are indicated on the vertical axis, with the shortest bar representing approximately 52% and the tallest bar representing approximately 62%. The chart does not include any annotations or emphasis on specific bars, and the bars are not sorted in any particular order.
model_annotations.Chinese: 这张柱状图展示了不同学习方法在三个不同科目（Mathverse、MMLU、Physics）中的准确率。图表的纵轴表示准确率（%），范围从50%到62%。横轴表示三个科目。每个科目下有五个柱子，分别代表不同的学习方法。DAPO+Self-reflection、DAPO、GRPO、PPO+Self-reflection、PPO和SRPO分别用不同的颜色和图案表示。柱子高度代表准确率，柱子底部的数字表示准确率的具体数值。柱子排序为从左到右的Mathverse、MMLU、Physics。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different educational methods across three subjects: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, while the horizontal axis lists the subjects. Each bar is color-coded to represent a specific educational method: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (orange), GRPO (green), SRPO (light blue), PPO+Self-reflection (dark green), and PPO (red). The bars are grouped by subject, allowing for a comparison of the methods within each subject. The accuracy percentages for each method are as follows: DAPO+Self-reflection scores around 56% in Mathverse, 58% in MMLU, and 60% in Physics; DAPO scores approximately 54% in Mathverse, 56% in MMLU, and 58% in Physics; GRPO scores around 56% in Mathverse, 58% in MMLU, and 60% in Physics; SRPO scores about 54% in Mathverse, 56% in MMLU, and 58% in Physics; PPO+Self-reflection scores around 56% in Mathverse, 58% in MMLU, and 60% in Physics; and PPO scores approximately 54% in Mathverse, 56% in MMLU, and 58% in Physics. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.German: Die bargezeichnete Grafik veranschaulicht die Genauigkeit verschiedener Algorithmen in drei verschiedenen Kategorien: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert den Prozentsatz der Genauigkeit, gemessen in Prozent, und die horizontale Achse zeigt die drei Kategorien. Die Genauigkeit wird durch die Höhe der einzelnen Balken dargestellt, wobei die Balken farblich und texturiert sind, um die verschiedenen Algorithmen zu unterscheiden. Die Algorithmen sind DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, PPO und PPO. Die Genauigkeit reicht von etwa 52% bis 62%. Die Genauigkeit der Algorithmen variiert je nach Kategorie, wobei einige Algorithmen in einigen Kategorien eine höhere Genauigkeit aufweisen als in anderen. Die Grafik zeigt keine Sortierung der Algorithmen oder besondere Hervorhebungen.
